stem: According to the excerpt, which goal was the focus of the Great Society?
visual_elements: The Great Society rests on abundance and liberty for all. It demands an end to poverty and racial injustice. . . .  The Great Society is a place where every child can find knowledge to enrich his mind and to enlarge his talents. . . .  It is a place where man can renew contact with nature. It is a place which honors creation for its own sake and for what it adds to the understanding of the race. It is a place where men are more concerned with the quality of their goals than the quantity of their goods.
